card_description:
**Priority:** P0 | **Location:** London/Luxembourg (European Focus) | **AUM:** ~$600M

**Investment Thesis:**
Founder-led thematic fund investing in the 'Superabundant future of Humanity' across Games, Metaverse Technologies, Digital Sports, AI, Cloud Infrastructure, and Compute. Focuses on UK, European and North American innovators. Strong appetite for live service game infrastructure and developer tooling.

**Why They're a Good Target:**
- Just led Sidero Labs ($4M, Oct 2024) - Kubernetes/container infrastructure for game developers showing active appetite for dev tooling
- Led Maintain Altitude pre-seed (Oct 2024) - demonstrating active seed-stage deployment
- Luke Alvarez has 29 years in technology and 20+ years in digital games - deep operator credibility
- Sir Ian Livingstone (CBE) is a gaming legend (co-founder Games Workshop, Eidos) - unmatched industry network
- Portfolio includes game infrastructure plays: Edgegap (game server orchestration), Sidero Labs, Player Data
- Fresh capital from Fund II ($326M raised Feb 2022) means active deployment mode
- London/European base provides timezone coverage and EU gaming ecosystem access

**Key Partners:**

| Name | Title | Background | Priority |
|------|-------|------------|----------|
| Luke Alvarez | Founding Managing Partner | 29 years tech/20+ years games, led Hiro strategy | PRIMARY |
| Sir Ian Livingstone | Co-Founding Partner | CBE, co-founded Games Workshop & Eidos, gaming legend | PRIMARY |
| Cherry Freeman | Co-Founding Partner | Platform/tech investment lead, deal execution | SECONDARY |
| Sam Costello | Operating Director | Strategy/deep dives for portfolio companies | TERTIARY |

**Portfolio Companies (Recent):**
- Sidero Labs ($4M Seed, Oct 2024) - Kubernetes/container infrastructure for game developers
- Maintain Altitude (£380K Pre-seed, Oct 2024) - Music/rhythm game studio
- Meeple Corp (£500K, Feb 2025) - Digital tabletop games platform
- Polyarc (Series B-II, June 2025) - VR game studio
- Snowprint Studios - Mid-core mobile games (acquired by MTG 2024)
- Edgegap - Game server orchestration infrastructure
- Keen Games - Enshrouded developer (3M+ units sold)

**Warm Path Opportunities:**
- Ian Livingstone network: Games Workshop, Eidos alumni
- Sidero Labs portfolio company connection
- European gaming conference circuit (Gamescom, Nordic Game)
- London gaming ecosystem connections

**Recommended Outreach Angle:**
**Subject:** Seed-Stage [Game Infrastructure/Dev Tools] - [Company Name]

**Hook:** Lead with live service infrastructure thesis alignment. Reference their Sidero Labs investment as validation of developer tooling appetite. Luke responds to technical depth - emphasize game engine or infrastructure experience. Ian's involvement signals they value creative/technical hybrid teams.

**Key Talking Points:**
1. Live service game infrastructure is underserved at seed stage in Europe
2. Direct validation: Sidero Labs investment shows active interest in dev tooling
3. Technical team with shipped game titles or infrastructure experience
4. London/EU gaming ecosystem angle (Hiro has strong EU presence)
5. AI-augmented game development or operations angle

**Contact Information:**
- Luke Alvarez: luke@hiro.capital | LinkedIn: /in/luke-alvarez-699988171
- Website: https://www.hiro.capital
- Fund: Active, deploying Fund II

**Research Sources:**
- https://www.hiro.capital/our-team/
- https://www.hiro.capital/companies/
- https://www.crunchbase.com/organization/hiro-capital
- CB Insights: Hiro Capital leads $4M in Sidero Labs (Oct 2024)
- InvestGame: Hiro Capital II $326M fund close analysis

**Next Action:** Send personalized cold email to Luke Alvarez emphasizing live service infrastructure and European gaming ecosystem angle.

Check for Sidero Labs or Edgegap portfolio company connections

Send cold email to Luke Alvarez with live service infrastructure angle
